title: Vulkan Plexified
description: A performance-focused modpack that uses the Vulkan rendering engine while keeping the number of optimization mods minimal to maintain performance.
body:
A simple, lightweight vulkan peformance mod that focus on maintaing the amount of optmization mods used.

### Why use this?
With Minecraft planning to move its rendering system from OpenGL to Vulkan, this mod acts as an early preview of that shift, allowing players to try Vulkan-based rendering before the official change arrives. This modpack is especially useful for low-end PCs that struggle to run vanilla Minecraft or large optimization packs with 50+ performance mods.

## Tests
I currently use an HP All-In-One Desktop PC with a 2x Intel Celeron G4900T CPU @ 2.90 GHZ Processor and 8 GiB of RAM Installed. **_Linux Fedora 43_**

I was able to get more than 60+ FPS on Fast presets that your able to configure in VulkanMod settings.
